verdict.rationale: The evidence covers OCR, page-level blocks, whole-document annotation against a user-provided schema, and multi-document Q&A. None of it documents automatic classification of document types within a packet, or splitting one upload into separate documents with per-document results. Document Q&A's 'multi-document queries' is a different capability and is not credited here.

support.subject: As a data engineer, multi-document packets are classified and split automatically — one upload, per-document results
